ValidationRule.description: restricts user from setting the status to Win approved and WIn submitted
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( Status__c ), OR(ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Win Submitted"),ISPICKVAL(Status__c , "Win Approved")), Not(Opportunity.Oppty_Pipeline__c == 'Design')
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Product status can not be set to Win Submitted or Win approved in the current opportunity stage. Please review with your Admin.
